general.title: General
general.description: The panel's name and picture in the sidebar.

data.title: Name in the sidebar
data.admin_only: Show the panel to administrators only

data_description.image: Default: the house photo shipped with the integration, /casa_static/casa.jpg. A picture in /config/www works too, e.g. /local/casa.jpg.

energy.title: Energy
energy.description: Power sensors and battery. The Deye sensors found are filled in; check them and choose the total production.

data.battery_invert: The battery sensor is negative while charging (Deye)
data.battery_kwh: Usable battery capacity (0 = no time left)

data_description.battery_reserve: The inverter does not discharge below it; time left counts down to it.

today.title: Energy today
today.description: Daily counters (kWh) and the solar forecast. Found ones are filled in; leave empty what you do not have.

data_description.price_import: What you pay per kWh taken from the grid, VAT included. Used for the monthly balance; 0 = hidden.
data_description.price_export: What you get (or are credited) per kWh sent to the grid.

heating.title: Heating
heating.description: Thermostats, buffer tank and the boiler room equipment.

data_description.thermostats: One per line: name = entity. For a thermostat that does not report when it heats, add the entity that shows its heat demand (on/off). Example: Shop = climate.shop = sensor.boiler_relay
data_description.equipment: One per line: name = entity, and = alert to show it in orange while it runs. Example: Boiler = switch.boiler = alert. Optionally on the same line: an input_select for the mode (a button to change it) and an input_text for the reason, e.g. Boiler = switch.baxi = alert = input_select.baxi_mod = input_text.baxi_motiv
data_description.mode_reason: Text entity where the automation writes what it decided, e.g. input_text.pdc_motiv. Shown under the heating mode.
data_description.programs: One per line: name = days = switch = start = end. Days: L-V for Monday–Friday, daily for every day. Times are HHMM numbers, as on the Shelly (545 = 05:45). Example: Program 1 = L-V = switch.wilo_program_1 = number.wilo_p1_start = number.wilo_p1_stop

data.alert_soc: Alert when the battery is below
data.alert_puffer: Alert when the buffer tank is below

data_description.hidro: One per line: name = contract number. Example: Home = 8001234567
data_description.devices: One per line: name = entity. Unavailable ones turn red after 5 minutes.
data_description.car: The OverDrive device id, e.g. overdrive_123456 (as in its entity ids). Empty = no car card.
data_description.lights: One per line: name = entity (switch or light). Example: Gazebo = switch.gazebo. The sunset / sunrise automation comes from the lumini_exterior.yaml package.
data_description.ac: One per line: name = climate entity. Example: Living room AC = climate.ac_living
